Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an incorrect instruction to “normalize” the developer to its parent company and report Square Enix as the developer. This conflated publisher/parent brand with the actual development studio. The correct developer of Tomb Raider (2013), the game in which Alice David voices Lara Croft, is Crystal Dynamics. This mis-specification led directly to the wrong final answer.
